host.description: TFTP server hostname or IP address. Optional — omitted for interactive use or when provided on command line.

port.description: TFTP server port. Default is 69 as per RFC1350.

timeout.description: Client timeout in seconds. Must be ≥1. Default matches atftp's built-in default.

options.description: List of custom TFTP options to pass to atftp (e.g., block size, window size, multicast). Each entry maps a TFTP option name to a value, matching --option or --mtftp syntax from the manpage. Example: {'name': 'blksize', 'value': '1428'}. Only standard options listed in manpage are supported.
